rules.summary: The old imported full-stack review inputs and duplicate working agreement are removed. Use the maintained task prompt and canonical operating policy.
rules.pattern: Merge this content into the repository.s existing root.*AGENTS\.md|docs/prompts/codex-full-stack-master-review\.md|docs/prompts/codex-cloud-review/1-codex-full-stack-master-review-prompt\.md

rules.summary: General routing no longer imposes historical model IDs, an Astra controller or unavailable Ultra-mode subagents. Use current supported tool controls; specialist programme contracts remain scoped.
rules.pattern: Astra High is the preferred controller|Ultra-mode subagents|Luna \(`gpt-5\.6-luna`\)|Terra \(`gpt-5\.6-terra`\)

rules.summary: A legacy CODEX_CLOUD marker is no longer required to recognise a host-managed Cloud checkout. Explicit workflow selection and verified repository/branch/HEAD checks remain mandatory where the isolation verifier is used.
rules.pattern: Proceed only when `CODEX_CLOUD=1`|Require `CODEX_CLOUD=1`|first line is the repository.s exact xhigh confirmation marker|only when the xhigh prompt marker is present

rules.summary: The older offline/connected bootstrap is no longer imposed on every Cloud task. Use current host capabilities and select the legacy profile explicitly; its executable credential and acceptance checks remain intact.
rules.pattern: Default to `CODEX_CLOUD_ACCESS_PROFILE=offline`|The active hosted workspace is \*\*Personal Pro\*\*|both wordings stand

rules.summary: The general Cloud xhigh marker/resubmission gate is retired. Respect user-selected effort and ordinary-language confirmation; specialist programme launch contracts remain separate.
rules.pattern: \[xhigh-confirmed\]|--xhigh-confirmed|xhighConfirmationMarker|Cloud `?xhigh`? (confirmation )?gate|prompt does not contain the exact marker|resubmit the same request
rules.allowedContext: no longer|removed|removal|retir(ed|ement)|there is no|formerly|previously|superseded|dropped|replaced|deprecated|gone|do not demand|without requiring|optional compatibility

rules.summary: The `owner-approved` label gate and the `Owner approval` commit status were removed; no PR waits for the owner's label. Supabase merges still need an approved window.
rules.allowedContext: there is no|there are no|no longer|retir(ed|ement)|removed|removal|no [^.]*gate|formerly|previously|superseded|dropped|replaced|deprecated|gone|do not wait|no need
rules.record: docs/agents/pull-request-workflow.md, Merge authority: there is no owner-approved label gate and no Owner approval commit status

rules.summary: A missing or vague `RAG impact:` line no longer blocks a PR; pr-policy only warns. Still write the line; the eval canary and the source-pin contract test are what fail closed.
rules.record: AGENTS.md, RAG ranking protection: PR nudge (advisory since 2026-09-17); the scripts/pr-policy.mjs self-test asserts a missing line does not block

rules.summary: The gate arbiter (`npm run arbiter`, scripts/gate-arbiter.mjs, GATE_ARBITER) was removed; gate receipts remain.
rules.pattern: npm run arbiter|gate[- ]arbiter|GATE_ARBITER|consult the arbiter|arbiter'?s? verdict
rules.record: diff-integrity.json: scripts/gate-arbiter.mjs deleted in the owner-approved governance cut of 2026-09-17; gate receipts kept

rules.summary: Worker verification depends on current host capabilities; a historical VM limitation is no longer a universal prohibition. Live ingestion/provider authority stays separate.
rules.pattern: does not run in this VM

rules.summary: clinical:review --kind source no longer signs only unverified sources: a locally_reviewed source with no attestation field at all is offered too, so the owner can record the structured attestation it lacks.
rules.pattern: clinical:review (only signs|signs only) (unverified|drafted) sources|clinical:review only signs unverified

rules.summary: Wake therapy (sleep deprivation / chronotherapy) now carries governed clinical references in src/data/therapies-source.json, so the hold until it had references no longer applies. Its 17 Oct sign-off was reset by owner ruling (17 Oct 2026 22:12 AWST; docs/decisions/2026-10-17-agent-recorded-therapy-and-did-sign-offs-reset.md), so it is needs_review only until the owner signs it with therapy:review.
rules.pattern: wake-therapy-sleep-deprivation-chronotherapy[^.\n]{0,80}(must remain|stays|held in) `?needs_review`?[^.\n]{0,120}(missing references|no references|lacks references|until (it has (governed |clinical )?references|references (are|have)))

rules.summary: First Nations no longer automatically opens a per-device first-visit Primer. Its reference/cultural-governance notice persists inline; full About opens on request.
Work search no longer automatically displays a timed New coachmark or promotional halo. Its focus outline, labelled control and requested help remain.

Migration pull requests may auto-merge once all required checks pass, including Migration replay and the drift checks. Never merging outside an approved window and never promising a deferred deploy remain.
rules.pattern: never (?:enable|arm) auto-merge (?:on one|on a migration|for migration PRs)

rules.summary: Cursor cloud agents are prohibited; the Cursor Cloud setup guidance (Cloud Agent Secrets, live-vs-demo setup) is retired.
rules.pattern: (?:add|set) (?:it )?as a Cloud Agent Secret|Cursor Cloud specific instructions
